integrity: The general statement has an analytical argument independent of finite reproducibility checks. Source dates refer to verified public arXiv submissions, not later journal revisions. No independent external scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite trees with positive variation edge weights and unweighted hop-radius. Exact one-input variation amplification only, not a global two-input nonlinear Lipschitz constant. A plausible 2013 morphology source lacked inspectable full text; novelty residual risk persists.
title: Exact weighted-variation amplification at every radius of tree max-dilation
